# Timetable libraries

This independent Spider Time interface uses the following libraries. It contains no original Sectograph application source.

- D3 path 3.1.0 and D3 shape 3.2.0: ISC. See d3-path-LICENSE.txt and d3-shape-LICENSE.txt.
- rrule 2.8.1: BSD-3-Clause. See rrule-LICENSE.txt.
- ical.js 2.2.1: MPL-2.0. See ical-js-LICENSE.txt. The bundled library is unmodified.

These libraries draw clock sectors and handle local recurrence and calendar imports. Live accounts use Spider's existing server endpoints.
